raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: arosics
  version: "1.13.2"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b485ff83fa0c85be03433d027f7ce81184f297f3ae66449c041269371754f8a0

build:
  number: 1
  skip: match(python, "<3.11")
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
  python:
    entry_points:
      - arosics = arosics.arosics_cli:main

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
    - setuptools-git
  run:
    - cartopy
    - cmocean
    - folium >=0.6.0,!=0.12.0
    - gdal
    - geoarray >=0.15.0
    - geojson
    - geopandas
    - holoviews >1.12.7
    - joblib >=1.3.0
    - matplotlib-base
    - numpy
    - pandas
    - plotly
    - pyproj >2.2.0
    - py-tools-ds >=0.23.2
    - python
    - scikit-image >=0.21.0
    - scikit-learn
    - scipy >=1.7.0
    - shapely

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - arosics
        - arosics.CoReg
        - arosics.CoReg_local
        - arosics.DeShifter
        - arosics.geometry
        - arosics.plotting
        - arosics.Tie_Point_Grid
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - arosics --help

about:
  summary: An Automated and Robust Open-Source Image Co-Registration Software for Multi-Sensor Satellite Data
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://git.gfz-potsdam.de/danschef/arosics

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mxr-conda
    - danschef
    - rluria14
    - ndmaxar
    - RyanHackney
